metadata.title: Spectral gaps near one quarter for Weil--Petersson random surfaces with growing cusp number
metadata.abstract: We prove that the spectral gap of a Weil--Petersson random hyperbolic surface of genus $g$ with $n=n(g)\ge1$ labelled cusps converges in probability to $1/4$ as $g\to\infty$, for every sequence $n=o(\sqrt g)$. More precisely, for each fixed $0<\varepsilon<1/4$, there are constants $C_\varepsilon\ge2$ and $g_\varepsilon\ge3$, independent of $n$, such that the expected number of nonzero $L^2$ eigenvalues in $(0,1/4-\varepsilon]$, counted with multiplicity and including residual eigenvalues, is at most $C_\varepsilon(n+1)^2/g$ whenever $g\ge g_\varepsilon$ and $g\ge C_\varepsilon(n+1)^2$. This proves a conjecture of Shen and Wu. A matching lower bound shows that the count estimate is optimal up to constants for each fixed $\varepsilon$, and that $n=o(\sqrt g)$ is necessary for convergence of the gap to $1/4$. The proof combines volume estimates uniform in the cusp count with polynomial approximation and a positive trace on truncated surfaces.

analysis.progressType: 随机谱隙极限及最优增长阈值
analysis.workSummary: 对具有n=n(g)≥1个标记尖点的Weil–Petersson随机双曲曲面，证明当n=o(√g)时谱隙以概率收敛到1/4。固定0<ε<1/4，存在仅依赖ε而独立于n的常数，使g≥g_ε且g≥C_ε(n+1)²时，区间(0,1/4−ε]内非零L²本征值计重数并含剩余谱本征值的期望数≤C_ε(n+1)²/g。匹配下界说明计数阶最优，并说明n=o(√g)对上述收敛必要。
techniques: 对尖点数一致的体积估计
analysis.breakthrough: 按作者报告解决Shen–Wu猜想并识别尖点增长的必要充分阈值，而非只固定尖点数。
analysis.limitations: 以概率收敛不是每条曲面序列的确定性收敛；ε固定时的阶最优不等于精确常数最优。计数范围排除零本征值且不是整个连续谱。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
